name: vlm_micronuclei_presence
description: Uses a VLM to detect the presence of micronuclei (small DAPI-positive bodies distinct from the main nucleus). This is a hallmark of genomic instability and DNA damage.
segmentation_prompt: Segment the nuclear region and immediate surroundings.
method_rationale: Distinguishing true micronuclei from debris or apoptotic bodies involves contextual judgment suitable for a VLM.
